components.name: Stepper
components.description: Shows where someone is in a multi-step flow from a list of steps. A preset of the Steps primitive in three looks; compose `Steps` directly for any other layout. Pair it with your own content and buttons, or let `Wizard` drive it.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description: Horizontal steps only. `bottom` centres labels under each indicator.

props.name: showNumbers
props.description: Numbers in the indicators. Off shows a small dot instead.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Lets people pick a step from the strip.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Keeps the strip visible but blocks picking, e.g. while saving.
